title: Token Pass credit now applies automatically across AI Gateway
description: Token Pass credit now applies automatically to included model usage through AI Gateway , whether a request authenticates with an API key, OIDC token, or fx login. No dedicated Token Pass API key is required, though you can still create one from the dashboard or the CLI for keys scoped only to featured models and providers. When Token Pass credit runs out for the billing period, requests from a standard key or OIDC token fall back to your team's AI Gateway credits. Token Pass keys still stop until the next billing period. Requests served through the Token Pass provider remain Zero Data Retention (ZDR). Fallback requests follow your team's setting. With team-wide ZDR enabled, they route only to ZDR providers. Available now for Token Pass subscribers on Pro teams. If you created a Token Pass key during setup, switch to a standard API key or OIDC token to get fallback. Learn more in the Token Pass documentation . Read more

title: Vercel Schedules is now in public beta
description: Vercel Schedules is now in public beta on all plans. Run tasks on a recurring cadence or at a single point in time, in production, preview, or custom environments. Schedules in vercel.json can target a private Vercel Function, an HTTP path, or a Vercel Queue topic, and schedules created at runtime target a Queue topic. Any schedule can be enabled, disabled, or run on demand without redeploying. Define a static schedule: Adding a schedule/v1beta trigger makes the function private. It has no public URL and only the Vercel schedule infrastructure can invoke it. Handle the dispatch: Create a schedule at runtime: Schedules is the successor to Cron Jobs . Existing Cron Jobs continue to work, and the migration guide covers moving them to Schedules. Schedules also power dynamic schedules in Eve and experimental scheduled tasks in Nitro projects . Vercel Schedules is billed starting at $5 per 1M runs and $10 per 1M creations on Pro and Enterprise. Hobby includes 500 schedule creations and 5,000 runs per month. Read the blog post for more on how Schedules works, then get started with the Schedules documentation . Read more
